submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint ONE independently hand-drawn native square 1254x1254 transparent RGBA full-body game sprite of this exact celestial musician girl. Single pose, one character, no sheet. Image1=identity and immutable hand ownership, Image2=direction and camera reference, Image3=approved clean bright rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted style; any Image4 is same-direction scale/continuity anchor. Keep purple high bun long hair, gold lotus/pearl crown, violet eyes, ivory-lavender-gold embroidered long sleeves, short tunic over puffy lavender trousers, ivory-purple boots, green waist knot, ONE rigid elongated flat purple-gold qin. Anatomical LEFT supports upper qin, anatomical RIGHT rests/grips lower string face, both hands continuously attached during run. Both shoulders and elbows rotate naturally with stride while retaining grips, no hand swap. Two arms and two legs only, coherent hips/knees/ankles and boot toes; do not hide all feet under skirt. Preserve actual alpha, translucent ribbons. Full silhouette within clear margins. Same global head/body size and camera, no zoom, no individual bbox fit or grounded recentering. Virtual canvas 1024 root(512,942), floor92%canvas. Head crown around13%canvas in contact phase and boots near92%, with small true run bob. STRICT SOUTH facing straight TOWARD VIEWER, front view, symmetric violet eyes, no sideways turn. Anatomical RIGHT arm/leg on SCREEN LEFT; LEFT arm/leg on SCREEN RIGHT. LEFT hand SCREEN RIGHT supports upper qin end at upper-right; RIGHT hand SCREEN LEFT lower strings at lower-left. Trace both arm chains and never swap. FRAME S03 of16, cycle cadence to review at640/720/800ms: RIGHT MIDSTANCE with LEFT PASSING, exact opposite of prior incorrect request03. SCREEN LEFT anatomical RIGHT leg bears body, RIGHT boot LOW around(x515,y1200), shin under hip and knee bent. Planted boot white TOP/FRONT visible with ONLY THIN outsole edge, not big sole aimed at camera. SCREEN RIGHT anatomical LEFT thigh raises FORWARD toward viewer, left knee up near hem and LEFT boot HIGH around(x735,y1030). Narrow passing phase: low screenLEFT right foot, high screenRIGHT left knee/boot. Do not swap. Ref4 same-direction identity/camera/scale only. Shoulders counterrotate softly, right shoulder forward as left knee swings, left-upper/right-lower grips immutable. Hair, sleeves and ribbons lag naturally and change with gait. No background, ground, shadow, text, border, particles, glow, motion lines, trails, extra props. Highest visual finish; project target2.5Sunburst/max is host-managed, not a submitted model parameter.
